headline: Vision Zero – Traffic Safety Program
whyItMatters: This development project affects the physical character and land use of Pittsburgh neighborhoods.
whatChanged: Pittsburgh's citywide program to eliminate all traffic fatalities and serious injuries, adopted formally in 2024 following the city's Complete Streets Policy (2016).
